hindi_translation.headline: ऑपरेशन फायरवॉल के तहत आंध्र प्रदेश काउंटर इंटेलिजेंस सेल ने पाकिस्तानी जासूसी रैकेट का भंडाफोड़ किया
hindi_translation.story_lead: आंध्र प्रदेश काउंटर इंटेलिजेंस सेल ने पाकिस्तानी खुफिया तंत्र के लिए काम करने वाले हनी-ट्रैपिंग और जासूसी नेटवर्क के सिलसिले में 13 भारतीय नौसेना कर्मियों को हिरासत में लिया है और दो लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया है। 'ऑपरेशन फायरवॉल-2026' के तहत चलाए गए इन बहु-राज्यीय छापों का उद्देश्य विशाखापत्तनम के पूर्वी नौसेना कमान से जुड़ी संवेदनशील रक्षा जानकारी जुटाने वालों को पकड़ना था।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
आंध्र प्रदेश पुलिस की काउंटर इंटेलिजेंस सेल (CIC) पाकिस्तानी खुफिया एजेंटों (PIOs) को संवेदनशील रक्षा डेटा लीक करने वाले हनी-ट्रैप से संचालित जासूसी रैकेट में अपनी कथित संलिप्तता के लिए कम से कम 13 भारतीय नौसेना कर्मियों से पूछताछ कर रही है। जहां 13 कर्मियों से अज्ञात स्थान पर पूछताछ की जा रही है, वहीं अधिकारियों ने दो संदिग्धों को औपचारिक रूप से गिरफ्तार किया है: विशाखापत्तनम नौसेना कमान से जुड़े नौसेना नाविक प्रदीप मुखर्जी और नौसेना के अनुबंधित ड्राइवर अन्नाम साई वरप्रसाद। 'ऑपरेशन फायरवॉल-2026' कूट नाम के तहत 1 अक्टूबर को शुरू किए गए समन्वित छापों के बाद CIC द्वारा कुल 18 संदिग्धों की पहचान की गई है।

इस नेटवर्क का पता लगाने के लिए, आंध्र प्रदेश, केरल, महाराष्ट्र, कर्नाटक, गुजरात, गोवा, दिल्ली, तमिलनाडु, छत्तीसगढ़ और बिहार सहित 10 राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों में काउंटर-इंटेलिजेंस की एक दर्जन टीमें तैनात की गईं। यह टीमें विभिन्न राज्यों के आतंकवाद विरोधी दस्तों, नौसेना अधिकारियों और स्थानीय पुलिस के साथ तालमेल बिठाकर काम कर रही थीं। जांच से पता चला कि पाकिस्तानी खुफिया एजेंटों ने लक्ष्यों से दोस्ती करने के लिए फेसबुक और इंस्टाग्राम पर फर्जी सोशल मीडिया प्रोफाइल का इस्तेमाल किया। दो प्रमुख संचालकों की पहचान जोशिता पल्ल और अनवी मेहता के रूप में हुई है।
hindi_translation.background_context: दिसंबर 2019 में, आंध्र प्रदेश CIC ने 'ऑपरेशन डॉलफिन नोज' के तहत विशाखापत्तनम में पूर्वी नौसेना कमान से जुड़े इसी तरह के जासूसी रैकेट का भंडाफोड़ किया था।

news.headline: CJI Surya Kant Scheduled to Preside Over NLSIU's 34th Annual Convocation After Resolving Earlier Row
news.story_lead: Chief Justice of India Surya Kant will attend the 34th annual convocation of the National Law School of India University (NLSIU) in Bengaluru as Chancellor on October 17. The event follows an earlier cancellation of the ceremony due to student objections regarding the presence of top legal figures.
news.full_article_text: Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant is set to participate in the 34th annual convocation of the National Law School of India University (NLSIU), Bengaluru, where he will preside over the ceremony in his capacity as the university's Chancellor. Veteran theatre and film personality Arundhati Nag has been invited as the Chief Guest to deliver the Convocation Address. The ceremony is scheduled to take place from 11 am to 1 pm at the Jnana Jyoti Auditorium on Palace Road in Bengaluru. This development follows an earlier decision by NLSIU to cancel its convocation ceremony originally slated for September 12, citing unavoidable circumstances, after which students were initially told degrees would be conferred in absentia. The initial resistance from NLSIU students stemmed from a broader controversy involving the National Academy of Legal Studies and Research (NALSAR), Hyderabad, where students had opposed the proposed attendance of CJI Kant. The tensions had escalated on August 13 when the Bar Council of India (BCI) directed State Bar Councils to halt the enrollment of NALSAR's graduating batch, though that directive was withdrawn within hours. NLSIU students and alumni expressed solidarity with NALSAR students and criticized the BCI's actions, leading to a situation where students objected to both BCI Chairman Manan Kumar Mishra and CJI Kant attending their event, and demanded an apology from the BCI. Subsequently, Justice Kant met with NLSIU students to listen to their grievances. Students were then asked to vote on attending a convocation with Kant present, with a majority supporting the arrangement on the condition that Mishra would not attend. The schedule hit another hurdle when students were asked to publicly invite Kant, which the graduating batch declined, leading to the cancellation of the September 12 event. Ultimately, NLSIU's governing bodies approved October 17 as the revised date, permitting students to receive their degrees either in person or in absentia.

hindi_translation.story_lead: भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश (सीजेआई) सूर्यकांत 17 अक्टूबर को बेंगलुरु में नेशनल लॉ स्कूल ऑफ इंडिया यूनिवर्सिटी (एनएलएसआईयू) के 34वें वार्षिक दीक्षांत समारोह में कुलाधिपति के रूप में शामिल होंगे। यह आयोजन पहले के उस विवाद के बाद हो रहा है जिसके कारण समारोह रद्द कर दिया गया था।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश (सीजेआई) सूर्यकांत बेंगलुरु स्थित नेशनल लॉ स्कूल ऑफ इंडिया यूनिवर्सिटी (एनएलएसआईयू) के 34वें वार्षिक दीक्षांत समारोह में विश्वविद्यालय के कुलाधिपति के रूप में भाग लेंगे। प्रख्यात थिएटर और फिल्म हस्ती अरुंधति नाग दीक्षांत भाषण देंगी। यह समारोह बेंगलुरु के पैलेस रोड स्थित ज्ञान ज्योति सभागार में सुबह 11 बजे से दोपहर 1 बजे तक आयोजित किया जाएगा। यह घटनाक्रम एनएलएसआईयू द्वारा 12 सितंबर को होने वाले समारोह को अपरिहार्य कारणों से रद्द करने के फैसले के बाद आया है। एनएलएसआईयू के छात्रों ने NALSAR हैदराबाद के छात्रों के साथ एकजुटता व्यक्त करते हुए सीजेआई सूर्यकांत और बार काउंसिल ऑफ इंडिया (बीसीआई) के अध्यक्ष मनन कुमार मिश्रा की उपस्थिति का विरोध किया था। इसके बाद सीजेआई ने छात्रों से मुलाकात कर उनकी चिंताएं सुनीं। छात्रों ने मतदान के जरिए सहमति व्यक्त की, जिसके बाद एनएलएसआईयू के प्रशासनिक निकायों ने 17 अक्टूबर को नई तारीख के रूप में मंजूरी दी।

news.headline: Two Cheetahs Transferred from Kuno to Veerangana Durgavati Tiger Reserve in Madhya Pradesh
news.story_lead: Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav has released two cheetahs, named Vyom and Neera, into the Veerangana Durgavati Tiger Reserve in Sagar district. This marks the first time cheetahs have been introduced into the reserve, which already hosts populations of tigers and leopards. State authorities have also announced plans to bring two additional cheetahs next month.
news.full_article_text:
Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav released two cheetahs, Vyom and Neera, into the Veerangana Durgavati Tiger Reserve (VDTR) located in Sagar district. This initiative marks the historic first introduction of cheetahs into the reserve. Both animals were brought from Kuno National Park.

According to field director Rajneesh Singh, five soft-release bomas have been constructed within the Muhali range to help the cheetahs acclimatize gradually to their new habitat. Security and monitoring measures have been established across an area spanning approximately 439 hectares.

During the release ceremony, Chief Minister Yadav stated that cheetahs coexist peacefully without human-animal conflict. He also highlighted the state's ecological standing, noting that Madhya Pradesh records the highest numbers of tigers and vultures in the country, alongside gharials in the Chambal river.

The Chief Minister announced that two more cheetahs are scheduled to arrive next month to help expand the population. Spanning an area of 2,300 square kilometers, VDTR currently supports around 30 tigers and 40 leopards, presenting an opportunity for African cheetahs to co-exist alongside them.

Historical translocation data shows that African cheetahs were first brought to India in September 2022, with previous arrivals comprising eight cheetahs from Namibia, 12 from South Africa, and nine from Botswana.

news.headline: Three Dead and Eleven Injured After Five-Storey Residential Building Collapses in New Seemapuri, Delhi
news.story_lead: A five-storey residential building collapsed in New Seemapuri, Delhi, on Wednesday afternoon, resulting in three fatalities and eleven injuries. Rescue operations by the Delhi Fire Services and NDRF are underway amid challenges posed by heavy concrete debris blocks.
news.full_article_text:
A five-storey residential building collapsed on Wednesday afternoon near Idgah Machhli Mandi in New Seemapuri, Delhi, claiming three lives and injuring eleven others. The structure, built on a plot measuring approximately 25 square yards, also partially damaged two adjoining buildings upon collapse. Delhi Fire Services (DFS) received the emergency call around 3:30 pm and dispatched four fire tenders to the site, initiating joint search and rescue operations alongside the National Disaster Response Force (NDRF).

Among the deceased were two children—including a 12-year-old girl and a toddler aged around 1.5 years. Eight injured individuals were initially rushed to GTB Hospital, whose emergency department is currently operational at the Rajiv Gandhi Hospital campus. Identified injured persons include building owner Anwar, his wife Salma, their son Abdur Rehman, three-year-old Abdan, and a tenant named Sakina. Relatives and residents reported several people trapped beneath the rubble, including a four-month pregnant woman named Gulfisha and her four-year-old daughter.

Rescue operations faced significant hurdles, with an NDRF official noting that large concrete ceiling blocks (lanters) fell onto the debris and required cranes for removal, slowing down access to trapped victims. The Delhi Traffic Police issued advisories urging commuters to avoid the Seemapuri roundabout, DLF Bhopura, and adjoining routes to keep lanes clear for ambulances and emergency vehicles. 

Locals alleged that demolition work using machinery on an adjacent property over the preceding five to six days had undermined their building's structural integrity. This tragedy follows a similar collapse in Delhi's Satya Niketan on September 6, which killed seven people, subsequently prompting the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) to increase enforcement against unauthorised construction and dangerous buildings in areas like Old Seemapuri.
news.background_context: The incident occurred a month after a boys' PG building collapsed in Delhi's Satya Niketan on September 6, which resulted in seven fatalities. Following that tragedy, the MCD stepped up enforcement against dangerous buildings and unauthorised construction, conducting demolition drives in Old Seemapuri.

hindi_translation.headline: दिल्ली के सीमापुरी में पांच मंजिला आवासीय इमारत ढही, तीन की मौत और ग्यारह घायल
hindi_translation.story_lead: दिल्ली के सीमापुरी इलाके में बुधवार दोपहर एक पांच मंजिला आवासीय इमारत ढह जाने से तीन लोगों की मौत हो गई और ग्यारह अन्य घायल हो गए। दिल्ली फायर सर्विसेज और एनडीआरएफ द्वारा बचाव अभियान जारी है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: दिल्ली के न्यू सीमापुरी में ईदगाह मछली मंडी के पास बुधवार दोपहर एक पांच मंजिला आवासीय इमारत ढह गई, जिसमें तीन लोगों की जान चली गई और ग्यारह अन्य घायल हो गए। लगभग 25 वर्ग गज के भूखंड पर बनी इस इमारत के गिरने से आसपास की दो अन्य इमारतें भी आंशिक रूप से क्षतिग्रस्त हो गईं। दिल्ली फायर सर्विसेज (DFS) को दोपहर करीब 3:30 बजे घटना की सूचना मिली और उसने चार दमकल गाड़ियां मौके पर भेजीं। DFS और राष्ट्रीय आपदा मोचन बल (NDRF) संयुक्त रूप से खोज और बचाव अभियान चला रहे हैं। मृतकों में दो बच्चे शामिल हैं। घायलों को जीटीबी अस्पताल के आपातकालीन विभाग में भर्ती कराया गया है, जो फिलहाल राजीव गांधी अस्पताल परिसर से संचालित हो रहा है। एनडीआरएफ के अधिकारियों ने बताया कि मलबे पर भारी कंक्रीट के स्लैब (लेंटर) गिरने के कारण उन्हें हटाने में क्रेन का उपयोग करना पड़ रहा है, जिससे बचाव कार्य में समय लग रहा है।

news.headline: Delhi Residential Building Collapse in New Seemapuri Triggers Rescue Operations and Traps Multiple Residents
news.story_lead: A five-storey residential building collapsed in Delhi's New Seemapuri area on Wednesday afternoon, trapping several individuals under the rubble. Emergency response agencies, including the Delhi Fire Services and the National Disaster Response Force, immediately launched rescue operations at the site.
news.full_article_text:
A five-storey residential building collapsed around 3:30 pm on Wednesday in E-Block, New Seemapuri, located within the Shahdara district of Delhi. The affected structure, identified as property number E-401, was built on a plot measuring approximately 25 square yards. The sudden collapse partially damaged two adjoining buildings and left multiple people trapped beneath the debris.

Rescue teams from the Delhi Fire Services (DFS), the National Disaster Response Force (NDRF), local police, and civic authorities rushed to the scene. Because the lanes on the immediate side of the collapsed structure were severely cramped, rescue operations were executed from the nearby Eidgah premises.

Relatives and residents at the site reported harrowing accounts. Sameena, a 30-year-old local resident, stated that her 21-year-old sister, Gulfisha—who is four months pregnant—was trapped inside alongside her four-year-old daughter and the property owner's daughter, and had managed to make a phone call reporting breathing difficulties. Another resident, Haseena, reported that her mother was trapped after being caught in the street during the collapse, while Mohammed Akbar, a relative of the building owner, noted that three family members were trapped under the debris.

Ameena, the daughter of the building owner Mohammed Anwar, claimed that an adjoining property had been undergoing mechanical demolition for five to six days, which allegedly impacted their residential structure. The family had constructed and moved into the collapsed building roughly four months prior.

Eight injured individuals were rescued from the site and rushed to the emergency department of GTB Hospital, which is currently operating from the Rajiv Gandhi Hospital campus. Among the identified injured are property owner Anwar, his wife Salma, their son Abdur Rehman, a three-year-old child named Abdan, and a tenant named Sakina. One fatality was reported in connection with the incident.
bullet_points: A five-storey residential building collapsed in E-Block, New Seemapuri, Delhi, around 3:30 pm on Wednesday.
The collapsed building (E-401) was constructed on a plot of approximately 25 square yards.
The incident partially damaged two adjoining buildings and left several people trapped.
Delhi Fire Services dispatched four fire tenders, and the National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) was deployed for rescue operations.
Rescue efforts were conducted from the Eidgah premises due to severely cramped lanes surrounding the site.
Eight injured individuals, including a three-year-old child (Abdan), were rescued and taken to GTB Hospital (operating from the Rajiv Gandhi Hospital campus).
One person was reported dead in the incident.
Family members alleged that an adjoining property had been undergoing mechanical demolition for five to six days prior to the collapse.
key_facts: Location: E-Block, New Seemapuri, Shahdara district, Delhi
Time and Date: Wednesday afternoon around 3:30 pm
Building details: Five-storey structure on a ~25 square yard plot, bearing number E-401
Injuries and Casualties: One death reported; eight individuals rescued and admitted to GTB Hospital

exam_relevance: Relevant for General Studies (Mains): Urban governance, disaster management, illegal construction, regulatory enforcement, and urban safety in Indian cities.
Relevant for Prelims: Awareness of disaster management frameworks (NDRF) and urban administration.
news.upsc_analysis: The New Seemapuri building collapse highlights recurring systemic vulnerabilities in India's urban areas, including unregulated construction on small plots, cramped residential layouts, and the lack of oversight during neighboring demolition or construction activities. It underscores the critical need for strict enforcement of municipal building codes, proactive hazard assessment in densely populated neighborhoods, and swift multi-agency disaster response protocols involving bodies like the NDRF and local fire services.

National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) was called in to assist with rescue operations.
Police and civic officials deployed personnel to manage the site and evacuate the injured to GTB Hospital.

Mandatory safety audits and regulation of mechanical demolition work near residential buildings.
Enhancement of urban disaster preparedness and rapid-response capabilities for densely populated localities.
news.mains_notes: The collapse of a five-storey building in New Seemapuri, Delhi, underscores systemic gaps in urban planning, municipal enforcement, and structural safety. Key issues involve construction on undersized plots, lack of supervision during neighboring demolitions, and challenges in disaster response due to congested lanes. Effective management requires rigorous enforcement of building bylaws, regular structural audits, and proactive municipal accountability to prevent urban tragedies.

hindi_translation.headline: दिल्ली के सीमापुरी में इमारत ढहने के बाद परिवारों ने अपनों की तलाश की; एक की मौत, आठ घायल
hindi_translation.story_lead: बुधवार दोपहर दिल्ली के न्यू सीमापुरी इलाके में पांच मंजिला रिहायशी इमारत ढहने से कई लोग मलबे के नीचे दब गए। दिल्ली अग्निशमन सेवा और राष्ट्रीय आपदा मोचन बल (एनडीआरएफ) सहित आपातकालीन एजेंसियों ने तुरंत बचाव अभियान शुरू किया।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
बुधवार दोपहर करीब 3:30 बजे दिल्ली के शाहदरा जिले के न्यू सीमापुरी में ई-ब्लॉक स्थित एक पांच मंजिला रिहायशी इमारत ढह गई। लगभग 25 वर्ग गज के भूखंड पर बनी ई-401 नंबर की इस इमारत के ढहने से दो आसपास की इमारतें भी आंशिक रूप से क्षतिग्रस्त हो गईं और कई लोग मलबे में फंस गए।

दिल्ली अग्निशमन सेवा (डीएफएस), राष्ट्रीय आपदा मोचन बल (एनडीआरएफ), पुलिस और नागरिक अधिकारियों ने घटनास्थल पर बचाव अभियान चलाया। प्रभावित इमारत के दूसरी तरफ की गलियां बेहद संकरी होने के कारण बचाव कार्य ईदगाह परिसर से चलाया गया।

स्थानीय लोगों और रिश्तेदारों ने डरावनी घटनाओं को बयां किया। तीस वर्षीय निवासी समीना ने बताया कि उनकी 21 वर्षीय बहन गुलफिशा, जो चार महीने की गर्भवती हैं, मलबे के नीचे से फोन करने में सफल रहीं और उन्होंने सांस लेने में कठिनाई बताई। संपत्ति मालिक के रिश्तेदार मोहम्मद अकबर ने बताया कि उनके परिवार के तीन सदस्य मलबे में फंसे हैं। मकान मालिक की बेटी अमीना ने दावा किया कि उनके घर से सटी इमारत को पिछले पांच-छह दिनों से मशीन से तोड़ा जा रहा था, जिससे उनके घर पर असर पड़ा।

अधिकारियों के अनुसार, बचाए गए आठ घायलों को जीटीबी अस्पताल के आपातकालीन विभाग में ले जाया गया, जो वर्तमान में राजीव गांधी अस्पताल परिसर से संचालित हो रहा है। घायलों में मकान मालिक अनवर, उनकी पत्नी सलमा, बेटा अब्दुर रहमान, तीन साल का बच्चा अब्दान और एक किराएदार सकीना शामिल हैं। इस हादसे में एक व्यक्ति की मौत की सूचना मिली है।
bullet_points: बुधवार दोपहर करीब 3:30 बजे दिल्ली के न्यू सीमापुरी के ई-ब्लॉक में पांच मंजिला इमारत ढह गई।
यह इमारत लगभग 25 वर्ग गज के भूखंड पर बनी हुई थी।
हादसे में आसपास की दो इमारतें भी क्षतिग्रस्त हो गईं और कई लोग फंस गए।
दिल्ली अग्निशमन सेवा और एनडीआरएफ द्वारा बचाव अभियान चलाया गया।
संकरी गलियों के कारण बचाव कार्य ईदगाह परिसर से किया गया।
तीन साल के बच्चे सहित आठ घायलों को जीटीबी अस्पताल में भर्ती कराया गया।
हादसे में एक व्यक्ति की मौत हो गई।
परिजनों ने आरोप लगाया कि पास की इमारत में पिछले कुछ दिनों से मशीनों से तोड़ने का काम चल रहा था।

news.headline: Maharashtra SRPF Jawan Dies After Venomous Snakebite at Gadchiroli Anti-Maoist Camp
news.story_lead: A 37-year-old State Reserve Police Force (SRPF) jawan deployed for anti-Maoist operations in Maharashtra's Gadchiroli district tragically died from a venomous snakebite. The incident occurred near a water tank at the Regadi camp while the personnel was preparing to bathe.
news.full_article_text: Police Naik Rahul Prabhakar Shingare, a 37-year-old State Reserve Police Force (SRPF) jawan attached to the 'F' Company of SRPF Group No. 6 based in Dhule, lost his life after being bitten by a venomous snake. Shingare was deployed in anti-Maoist operations in Maharashtra's Gadchiroli district, where his company had been stationed for approximately a month and a half, accommodated near the Regadi Police Aid Centre. The incident took place at around 11 am on Tuesday when Shingare went to take a bath near a large water tank in the camp, and a venomous snake bit his hand. Fellow officers immediately rushed him to the Chamorshi Rural Hospital, situated 40 kilometres away. Due to a deterioration in his condition, he was subsequently transferred to the District General Hospital in Gadchiroli, where he passed away during treatment later that evening. Reports noted that Shingare was also working as a snake charmer and was known for rescuing snakes. A state-honour condolence salute was conducted at the police drill ground in Gadchiroli, involving a three-round aerial firing in the presence of Gadchiroli Superintendent of Police (SP) M Ramesh, senior police officials, SRPF officers, and fellow jawans. Following necessary legal formalities and an autopsy, his body was handed over for final rites. In a separate operation on the same day, Gadchiroli Police and security forces uncovered and destroyed a substantial cache of buried weapons, explosives, and Maoist material in the Koparshi forest area under the Bhamragad subdivision near the Maharashtra-Chhattisgarh border. The seized items included a .303 rifle, two single-shot rifles, two country-made pistols, a Barrel Grenade Launcher (BGL), live cartridges, detonators, walkie-talkies, and Maoist literature.
bullet_points: A 37-year-old SRPF jawan, Police Naik Rahul Prabhakar Shingare, died following a venomous snakebite in Gadchiroli district.
The deceased was attached to the 'F' Company of SRPF Group No. 6 based in Dhule and was deployed for anti-Maoist operations.
The incident occurred around 11 am on Tuesday near a large water tank at the camp near the Regadi Police Aid Centre.
Shingare was first rushed to Chamorshi Rural Hospital (40 km away) and later shifted to the District General Hospital in Gadchiroli.
The jawan was reportedly also known as a snake charmer who rescued snakes.
A condolence salute featuring a three-round aerial firing was held at the Gadchiroli police drill ground under SP M Ramesh.
In a separate security operation on Tuesday, police and security forces destroyed a cache of buried weapons and Maoist material in the Koparshi forest area near the Maharashtra-Chhattisgarh border.

news.upsc_analysis: The incident highlights the demanding field conditions and environmental hazards faced by security personnel deployed in remote, forested regions for anti-Maoist operations. Simultaneously, ongoing operations in areas like the Bhamragad subdivision underline persistent security challenges along inter-state borders.

hindi_translation.headline: महाराष्ट्र: गढ़चिरौली शिविर में जहरीले सांप के काटने से एसआरपीएफ जवान की मौत
hindi_translation.story_lead: महाराष्ट्र में माओवादी विरोधी अभियानों में तैनात 37 वर्षीय राज्य रिजर्व पुलिस बल (एसआरपीएफ) के एक जवान की जहरीले सांप के काटने से मौत हो गई। यह घटना रेगाड़ी स्थित एक शिविर में हुई।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: धुले स्थित एसआरपीएफ ग्रुप संख्या 6 की 'एफ' कंपनी से जुड़े पुलिस नाइक राहुल प्रभाकर शिंगारे (37) की जहरीले सांप के काटने से मौत हो गई। जवान महाराष्ट्र के गढ़चिरौली जिले में माओवादी विरोधी अभियानों में तैनात था। अधिकारियों के अनुसार, एसआरपीएफ कंपनी को लगभग डेढ़ महीने पहले गढ़चिरौली भेजा गया था और कर्मियों को रेगाड़ी पुलिस सहायता केंद्र के पास ठहराया गया था। मंगलवार को सुबह करीब 11 बजे जब शिंगारे शिविर में एक बड़ी पानी की टंकी के पास नहाने गए, तो एक जहरीले सांप ने उनके हाथ पर काट लिया। साथी अधिकारियों ने तुरंत उन्हें 40 किलोमीटर दूर चामोर्शी ग्रामीण अस्पताल पहुंचाया। हालत बिगड़ने पर उन्हें गढ़चिरौली के जिला सामान्य अस्पताल में स्थानांतरित किया गया, जहां इलाज के दौरान शाम को उनकी मृत्यु हो गई। खबरों के अनुसार, शिंगारे सांप पकड़ने का काम भी करते थे। गढ़चिरौली के पुलिस परेड ग्राउंड में राजकीय सम्मान के साथ शोक सलामी दी गई, जिसमें हवा में तीन राउंड गोलियां चलाई गईं। इस दौरान गढ़चिरौली के पुलिस अधीक्षक (एसपी) एम रमेश, वरिष्ठ पुलिस अधिकारी, एसआरपीएफ अधिकारी और साथी जवान उपस्थित थे। आवश्यक कानूनी औपचारिकताएं और पोस्टमॉर्टम पूरा करने के बाद शव अंतिम संस्कार के लिए सौंप दिया गया। इस बीच, मंगलवार को एक अन्य अभियान में गढ़चिरौली पुलिस और सुरक्षा बलों ने महाराष्ट्र-छत्तीसगढ़ सीमा के पास भामरागढ़ उपखंड के अंतर्गत कोपारसी वन क्षेत्र में माओवादियों द्वारा दबाकर रखे गए हथियारों, विस्फोटकों और सामग्री के एक बड़े ज्‍खीरे को बरामद कर नष्ट कर दिया। जब्त की गई सामग्री में एक .303 राइफल, दो सिंगल-शॉट राइफलें, दो देसी पिस्तौल, एक बैरल ग्रेनेड लॉन्चर (बीजीएल), जिंदा कारतूस, डेटोनेटर, वॉकी-टॉकी और माओवादी साहित्य शामिल था।
bullet_points: गढ़चिरौली जिले में जहरीले सांप के काटने से एसआरपीएफ जवान राहुल प्रभाकर शिंगारे की मौत हो गई।
मृतक जवान धुले स्थित एसआरपीएफ ग्रुप 6 की 'एफ' कंपनी से संबंधित था और माओवादी विरोधी अभियानों में तैनात था।
यह घटना रेगाड़ी पुलिस सहायता केंद्र के पास शिविर में पानी की टंकी के नजदीक मंगलवार को सुबह करीब 11 बजे हुई।
शुरुआत में जवान को चामोर्शी ग्रामीण अस्पताल ले जाया गया और बाद में गढ़चिरौली जिला सामान्य अस्पताल रैफर किया गया।
गढ़चिरौली पुलिस परेड ग्राउंड में पुलिस अधीक्षक एम रमेश की उपस्थिति में राजकीय सम्मान के साथ शोक सलामी दी गई।
सुरक्षा बलों ने एक अन्य अभियान में कोपारसी वन क्षेत्र से माओवादी हथियार और विस्फोटक सामग्री बरामद कर नष्ट की।

news.headline: Veteran Actor Mithun Chakraborty Appointed as Special Cultural Advisor to West Bengal Government with Cabinet Rank
news.story_lead: The West Bengal government has appointed veteran actor and BJP national executive member Mithun Chakraborty as the special advisor to the information and cultural affairs department. He will hold the rank of a cabinet minister in the administration headed by Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari.
news.full_article_text:
The West Bengal government has officially appointed veteran film actor and Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) national executive member Mithun Chakraborty as the special advisor to the information and cultural affairs (I & CA) department. According to a state official, Chakraborty will hold the prestigious rank of a cabinet minister. The decision was originally announced by Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari during the birth centenary celebration of the legendary Bengali movie icon Uttam Kumar in September, with the formal order being issued on Wednesday.

Chakraborty, 76, is a former Bollywood superstar and holds iconic status in West Bengal. He formally joined the BJP at a public rally in Kolkata on March 7, 2021, just ahead of the state assembly elections when Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the gathering. Although his entry into the party sparked widespread speculation that he might be named the chief ministerial candidate, he ultimately served as a prominent star campaigner during the 2021 assembly elections, the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, and the subsequent state polls in April where the BJP successfully unseated the Trinamool Congress government.

Prior to his association with the BJP, Chakraborty had a tenure in parliamentary politics, having been elected to the Rajya Sabha as a Member of Parliament in February 2014 on a Trinamool Congress ticket before resigning from the Upper House in December 2016. As of now, the veteran actor has not made any public comments regarding his newly assigned administrative role.

The position carries the rank of a cabinet minister.
The information and cultural affairs department is headed by Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari.
The decision was initially revealed during the birth centenary celebrations of Bengali cinema icon Uttam Kumar in September.

He served as a key star campaigner for the BJP in the 2021, 2024, and April state elections.
He previously served as a Rajya Sabha MP from February 2014 to December 2016 on a Trinamool Congress ticket.

hindi_translation.headline: दिग्गज अभिनेता मिथुन चक्रवर्ती को कैबिनेट मंत्री के दर्जे के साथ बीजेपी शासित बंगाल सरकार का सांस्कृतिक सलाहकार नियुक्त किया गया
hindi_translation.story_lead: पश्चिम बंगाल सरकार ने दिग्गज अभिनेता और भारतीय जनता पार्टी के राष्ट्रीय कार्यकारी सदस्य मिथुन चक्रवर्ती को सूचना एवं सांस्कृतिक मामलों के विभाग का विशेष सलाहकार नियुक्त किया है। वह मुख्यमंत्री सुवेंदु अधिकारी के नेतृत्व वाले प्रशासन में कैबिनेट मंत्री का दर्जा संभालेंगे।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
पश्चिम बंगाल सरकार ने आधिकारिक तौर पर दिग्गज फिल्म अभिनेता और भारतीय जनता पार्टी (भाजपा) के राष्ट्रीय कार्यकारी सदस्य मिथुन चक्रवर्ती को सूचना और सांस्कृतिक मामलों (I & CA) विभाग का विशेष सलाहकार नियुक्त किया है। एक राज्य अधिकारी के अनुसार, चक्रवर्ती कैबिनेट मंत्री का दर्जा संभालेंगे। मुख्यमंत्री सुवेंदु अधिकारी ने सितंबर में बंगाली फिल्मों के दिग्गज प्रतीक उत्तम कुमार की जन्म शताब्दी समारोह के दौरान इस निर्णय की घोषणा की थी, और बुधवार को औपचारिक आदेश जारी किया गया।

76 वर्षीय चक्रवर्ती एक पूर्व बॉलीवुड सुपरस्टार हैं और बंगाल में एक आइकन का दर्जा रखते हैं। उन्होंने प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी के संबोधन से ठीक एक घंटे पहले 7 मार्च, 2021 को कोलकाता में एक रैली में औपचारिक रूप से भारतीय जनता पार्टी की सदस्यता ली थी। हालांकि उनके पार्टी में शामिल होने से यह अटकलें तेज हो गई थीं कि उन्हें चुनावों के लिए भाजपा के मुख्यमंत्री चेहरे के रूप में पेश किया जा सकता है, लेकिन उन्होंने 2021 के विधानसभा चुनावों, 2024 के लोकसभा चुनावों और इस साल अप्रैल में हुए पिछले राज्य चुनावों में एक स्टार प्रचारक की भूमिका निभाई, जिसमें भाजपा ने अंततः तृणमूल कांग्रेस सरकार को बाहर करने में सफलता हासिल की।

राजनीति में आने से पहले, चक्रवर्ती फरवरी 2014 में तृणमूल कांग्रेस के टिकट पर राज्यसभा सांसद बने थे और दिसंबर 2016 में उन्होंने उच्च सदन से इस्तीफा दे दिया था। फिलहाल, इस अनुभवी अभिनेता ने अपनी नियुक्ति पर कोई प्रतिक्रिया नहीं दी है।
bullet_points: मिथुन चक्रवर्ती को पश्चिम बंगाल के सूचना और सांस्कृतिक मामलों के विभाग का विशेष सलाहकार नियुक्त किया गया है।
इस पद पर कैबिनेट मंत्री का दर्जा प्राप्त होगा।
सूचना और सांस्कृतिक मामलों के विभाग का नेतृत्व मुख्यमंत्री सुवेंदु अधिकारी करते हैं।
यह निर्णय बंगाली सिनेमा के दिग्गज उत्तम कुमार की जन्म शताब्दी के अवसर पर सितंबर में घोषित किया गया था।
चक्रवर्ती 76 वर्ष के हैं और पश्चिम बंगाल में अत्यधिक लोकप्रिय पूर्व बॉलीवुड सुपरस्टार हैं।
उन्होंने प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी की उपस्थिति में 7 मार्च 2021 को कोलकाता की एक रैली में भाजपा ज्वाइन की थी।
उन्होंने 2021, 2024 और अप्रैल के चुनावों में भाजपा के लिए स्टार प्रचारक के रूप में कार्य किया।
उन्होंने फरवरी 2014 से दिसंबर 2016 तक तृणमूल कांग्रेस के टिकट पर राज्यसभा सांसद के रूप में कार्य किया था।

news.headline: Opposition seeks meeting with President Murmu over SIR and CEC removal, Brittas' complaint forwarded to government
news.story_lead: Opposition parties have requested an appointment with President Droupadi Murmu to address allegations of mass disenfranchisement and demand the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Meanwhile, CPI(M) MP John Brittas announced that the President has forwarded his earlier complaint against the CEC to the legislative department for appropriate action.
news.full_article_text:
Opposition parties have sought an urgent meeting with President Droupadi Murmu to present their grievances regarding SIR and to press for the removal of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar, citing allegations of mass disenfranchisement. The proposed delegation includes top leaders from INDIA bloc parties as well as the Leaders of the Opposition, with requests submitted for an appointment on Thursday or Friday to sustain the momentum of ongoing protests.

Simultaneously, CPI(M) Rajya Sabha MP John Brittas revealed that President Murmu responded to his formal letter sent on September 23, wherein he sought action against CEC Gyanesh Kumar for alleged unconstitutional and illegal acts. The President forwarded Brittas's communication to the legislative department with directives to take appropriate action, a response Brittas interpreted as a positive step toward the potential removal of the CEC.

The political tensions follow a large-scale protest march on Tuesday involving over 300 Opposition MPs attempting to reach the Election Commission headquarters at Nirvahan Sadan. The march was halted by the Delhi Police near Akashvani Bhavan, roughly 300 meters from the poll body's headquarters. The protest extended into the evening as prominent leaders, including Lok Sabha Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi, Wayanad MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, and Congress general secretary KC Venugopal, stayed put at the Akashvani Bhavan campus before being detained.

On Wednesday, Opposition parties—excluding the Samajwadi Party—resumed protests by attempting a march toward Jantar Mantar following a lunch meeting at a central Delhi restaurant, which also resulted in police detentions and travel bars. Legal and parliamentary experts, such as former Lok Sabha secretary general PDT Achari, noted that the President’s response to an individual MP's private letter is legally distinct from, and does not preclude, a collective representation or meeting sought by the broader Opposition leadership.

Former Lok Sabha secretary general PDT Achari clarified that an individual MP's correspondence response does not impact or prevent a separate meeting with the President by the wider Opposition.

hindi_translation.headline: विपक्ष ने एसआईआर और मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त को हटाने को लेकर राष्ट्रपति से मिलने का समय मांगा, ब्रिटस की शिकायत सरकार को भेजी गई
hindi_translation.story_lead: विपक्षी दलों ने बड़े पैमाने पर मताधिकार से वंचित करने के आरोपों को उठाने और मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार को हटाने की मांग को लेकर राष्ट्रपति द्रौपदी मुर्मू से मिलने का अनुरोध किया है। इस बीच, माकपा सांसद जॉन ब्रिटस ने बताया कि राष्ट्रपति ने इसी तरह के मुद्दों पर उनके पत्र को उचित कार्रवाई के लिए विधायी विभाग को भेज दिया है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
विपक्षी दलों ने एसआईआर से जुड़े मुद्दों को उठाने और बड़े पैमाने पर मताधिकार से वंचित करने के आरोपों के बीच मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त (सीईसी) ज्ञानेश कुमार को हटाने की मांग को लेकर राष्ट्रपति द्रौपदी मुर्मू से मुलाकात का समय मांगा है। प्रस्तावित प्रतिनिधिमंडल में इंडिया ब्लॉक के शीर्ष दलों के नेता और विपक्ष के दोनों नेता शामिल हैं, जिन्होंने विरोध प्रदर्शनों की गति बनाए रखने के लिए गुरुवार या शुक्रवार को मिलने का अनुरोध किया है...

इस बीच, माकपा के राज्यसभा सांसद जॉन ब्रिटस ने खुलासा किया कि राष्ट्रपति ने 23 सितंबर को भेजे गए उनके औपचारिक पत्र का जवाब दिया है, जिसमें उन्होंने सीईसी ज्ञानेश कुमार के कथित असंवैधानिक और अवैध कृत्यों के खिलाफ कार्रवाई की मांग की थी। राष्ट्रपति सचिवालय ने ब्रिटस के पत्र को उचित कार्रवाई के निर्देश के साथ विधायी विभाग को भेज दिया है।

यह राजनीतिक घटनाक्रम मंगलवार को 300 से अधिक विपक्षी सांसदों के एक बड़े मार्च के बाद सामने आया है, जो निर्वाचन आयोग के मुख्यालय निर्वाचन सदन की ओर बढ़ रहा था। इस मार्च को दिल्ली पुलिस ने आकाशवाणी भवन के पास रोक दिया। इसके बाद कांग्रेस नेता राहुल गांधी, प्रियंका गांधी वाड्रा और केसी वेणुगोपाल सहित कई नेताओं ने आकाशवाणी भवन परिसर में धरना दिया और बाद में उन्हें हिरासत में ले लिया गया।

बुधवार को समाजवादी पार्टी को छोड़कर विपक्षी दलों ने मध्य दिल्ली के एक रेस्तरां में दोपहर के भोजन के बाद जंतर-मंतर की ओर मार्च करने का प्रयास किया, जिसके बाद पुलिस ने उन्हें फिर से हिरासत में ले लिया। लोकसभा के पूर्व महासचिव पीडीटी आचारी ने बताया कि किसी सांसद के निजी पत्र पर राष्ट्रपति की प्रतिक्रिया और विपक्षी नेताओं द्वारा सामूहिक रूप से मिलने का अनुरोध दोनों अलग-अलग स्थितियां हैं।

news.headline: Jharkhand Widow's Barefoot 1,600m Sprint Wins Hearts Ahead of Home Guard Recruitment
news.story_lead: A video of a widowed mother running a 1,600-metre sprint barefoot during a practice session in Jharkhand's Ramgarh district has gone viral online. Kavita Mahto completed the trial run well ahead of the official time limit, showcasing remarkable determination to secure a job to support her dependent family.
news.full_article_text: A heartwarming video clip featuring Kavita Mahto, a widowed mother participating in a practice session without shoes or proper sports kits, has captured widespread public attention online. The practice trials were organized on October 4 at the HMT Physical Academy in Dulmi, located in Jharkhand's Ramgarh district. The session was arranged to help local applicants prepare for an upcoming home guard recruitment drive aiming to select 284 home guards at the same grounds between October 24 and November 5. According to Ajay Karmali, director of the HMT Physical Academy, Mahato completed the required 1,600-metre run in just 7 minutes, comfortably beating the official 10-minute time limit stipulated for women during home guard recruitment trials. Personal hardships underscore her arduous journey: Kavita lost her husband to illness three years ago, and six months prior to the trials, her brother-in-law—who also supported the household—died in a road accident. She currently works as a house help and is the sole breadwinner for two children under 12, alongside her elderly mother-in-law and father-in-law. Following the viral attention, the academy provided her with a proper kit. Furthermore, a government official noted that Kavita holds strong prospects of securing employment during the drive, as 50% of the seats are reserved for women, with an additional 5% reservation specifically designated for widowed and divorced women.

news.upsc_analysis: The incident highlights the socio-economic vulnerabilities faced by single women in rural and semi-urban India, while demonstrating the efficacy of affirmative policies like gender-based reservations in public sector recruitment and auxiliary security forces like home guards.
causes: Economic necessity following the deaths of her husband and brother-in-law, leaving her as the sole provider for an elderly in-laws and two young children.
impacts: The viral video drew nationwide praise for her determination and led to institutional support, including a proper sports kit provided by the local academy.

State-sponsored recruitment policies with targeted reservations play a vital role in integrating vulnerable demographics into the formal workforce.

hindi_translation.story_lead: झारखंड के रामगढ़ जिले में होम गार्ड भर्ती अभियान से पहले एक अभ्यास सत्र के दौरान नंगे पैर 1,600 मीटर की दौड़ लगाने वाली एक विधवा मां का वीडियो इंटरनेट पर वायरल हो गया है। कविता महतो ने आधिकारिक समय सीमा से काफी पहले यह दूरी तय की।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: झारखंड के रामगढ़ जिले के दुलमी स्थित एचएमटी फिजिकल अकादमी में 4 अक्टूबर को आयोजित अभ्यास सत्र के दौरान बिना जूतों और किट के 1,600 मीटर की दौड़ पूरी करने वाली कविता महतो की कहानी ने लोगों का दिल जीत लिया है। यह ट्रायल 24 अक्टूबर से 5 नवंबर के बीच होने वाली होम गार्ड भर्ती के लिए आयोजित किया गया था, जिसमें 284 होम गार्डों का चयन किया जाना है। अकादमी के निदेशक अजय कर्माली के अनुसार, महिलाओं के लिए निर्धारित 10 मिनट की समय सीमा के मुकाबले कविता ने यह दूरी मात्र 7 मिनट में तय कर ली। कविता के पति का तीन वर्ष पहले बीमारी से निधन हो गया था और छह महीने पहले उनके भाई-नंद की भी सड़क दुर्घटना में मौत हो गई थी। वह अपने दो बच्चों और सास-ससुर का भरण-पोषण करने के लिए घरेलू सहायिका के रूप में काम करती हैं। सरकारी नियमों के अनुसार, होम गार्ड भर्ती में 50 प्रतिशत सीटें महिलाओं के लिए आरक्षित हैं, तथा विधवा और तलाकशुदा महिलाओं के लिए अतिरिक्त 5 प्रतिशत आरक्षण का प्रावधान है।

रामगढ़ जिले के दुलमी स्थित एचएमटी फिजिकल अकादमी में 4 अक्टूबर को अभ्यास ट्रायल हुआ था।

news.headline: National Security Adviser Ajit Doval Holds Security Talks with Visiting Canadian Official David Morrison
news.story_lead: National Security Adviser Ajit Doval met with David Morrison, Senior Advisor to the Canadian prime minister, in India to enhance security and law enforcement collaboration. The discussions included India raising strong concerns regarding pro-Khalistani activities operating from Canadian territory, marking a continued thaw in bilateral ties following recent diplomatic friction.
news.full_article_text:
National Security Adviser Ajit Doval held high-level discussions with David Morrison, Senior Advisor to the Canadian prime minister, during his visit to India. The primary focus of the talks was to bolster bilateral cooperation in the realms of security and law enforcement. During the meeting, the Indian delegation explicitly raised its concerns regarding the activities of pro-Khalistani elements operating from Canadian soil.

Bilateral relations between India and Canada had previously hit a significant low following allegations made in 2023 by then Prime Minister Justin Trudeau regarding a potential Indian connection to the killing of Sikh separatist Hardeep Singh Nijjar, an accusation that New Delhi firmly dismissed as absurd. The diplomatic rift escalated in October 2024 when India recalled its high commissioner Sanjay Kumar Verma along with five other diplomats after Ottawa attempted to link them to the Nijjar case, leading to New Delhi expelling an equivalent number of Canadian diplomats in response.

However, ties began to recover following the victory of Liberal Party leader Mark Carney in the parliamentary election held in April of the previous year. Following this political shift, both nations reinstated their high commissioners in their respective capitals and agreed to reactivate several collaborative mechanisms across multiple sectors. Relations have experienced a major upswing since the visit of Canadian Prime Minister Carney to India in March.

news.headline: Meta Actioned 5.3 Million Child Abuse Content Pieces in India in H1 2026 and Deploys New AI Tools for Ads
news.story_lead: Technology major Meta disclosed that it acted on 5.3 million pieces of child sexual exploitation content in India during the first half of 2026, finding over 98 percent of it proactively before anyone reported it. The disclosure accompanies the rollout of new artificial intelligence tools designed to combat deceptive advertising tactics used by predators to direct users to illegal off-platform material.
news.full_article_text:
Meta announced the deployment of new artificial intelligence systems to target advertisements that covertly lead users to child abuse material. The company disclosed that between January and June 2026, it took action on 5.3 million pieces of child sexual exploitation content in India across Facebook and Instagram. Globally, Meta actioned 33.2 million such items during the same six-month period, with more than 97 percent identified proactively.

In India specifically, over 98 percent of the problematic content was detected and addressed prior to any user reports. According to the company, predators have adapted their tactics by utilizing advertisements that appear benign on their own but redirect individuals to illegal materials hosted outside Meta's platforms. Upon identifying this pattern, Meta expanded its investigations beyond individually reported ads, disabled associated accounts, and blocked the involved off-platform links.

The newly introduced countermeasures feature a large language model system engineered to spot 'signposting', which refers to ad content that appears harmless while strongly suspected of directing people toward illicit material. Furthermore, Meta enhanced its assessment capabilities regarding where an advertisement ultimately leads rather than solely evaluating its visual appearance. Additional upgrades include AI-driven sweeps to capture material missed by older systems, a red-teaming AI agent designed to probe internal defenses for vulnerabilities, and strengthened mechanisms to catch banned users attempting to open new accounts.

These disclosures arrive amid a broader government crackdown in India concerning child sexual exploitation material. In July, the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology issued a formal notice to Meta instructing the removal of such advertisements on Instagram and summoned the company's global executives to India. Consequently, Meta agreed to report child safety incidents directly to the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) portal.
news.background_context: The disclosure follows a government crackdown initiated in July when the IT ministry issued a notice to Meta regarding child sexual abuse ads on Instagram and summoned global executives.
bullet_points: Meta acted on 5.3 million pieces of child sexual exploitation content in India in the first half of 2026.
Globally, the tech major actioned 33.2 million such items between January and June, with over 97 per cent caught proactively.
More than 98 per cent of the abusive content on Facebook and Instagram in India was detected before being reported.

The company deployed a red-teaming AI agent to test its own platform defenses for security weaknesses.

news.upsc_analysis: The news highlights the intersection of technological intervention, intermediary liability, and regulatory oversight in India's digital ecosystem. It underscores the effectiveness of proactive AI moderation by tech giants while illustrating how statutory pressure from bodies like MeitY and the utilization of national cybersecurity frameworks like I4C can compel corporate accountability in protecting vulnerable demographics online.

hindi_translation.headline: मेटा ने H1 2026 में भारत में बाल शोषण सामग्री के 53 लाख मामलों पर कार्रवाई की; विज्ञापनों की जांच के लिए नए AI टूल लॉन्च किए
hindi_translation.story_lead: प्रौद्योगिकी दिग्गज मेटा ने खुलासा किया कि उसने 2026 की पहली छमाही के दौरान भारत में बाल यौन शोषण सामग्री के 5.3 मिलियन मामलों पर कार्रवाई की, जिसमें किसी की रिपोर्ट करने से पहले 98 प्रतिशत से अधिक सामग्री का सक्रिय रूप से पता लगाया गया। यह खुलासा विज्ञापनों के माध्यम से उपयोगकर्ताओं को अवैध सामग्री की ओर ले जाने वाली भ्रामक रणनीतियों से निपटने के लिए बनाए गए नए कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता उपकरणों की शुरुआत के साथ हुआ है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
मेटा ने उन विज्ञापनों की जांच करने के लिए नई कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता प्रणालियों को तैनात करने की घोषणा की जो गुप्त रूप से उपयोगकर्ताओं को बाल शोषण सामग्री की ओर ले जाते हैं। कंपनी ने खुलासा किया कि जनवरी और जून 2026 के बीच, उसने फेसबुक और इंस्टाग्राम पर भारत में बाल यौन शोषण सामग्री के 5.3 मिलियन टुकड़ों पर कार्रवाई की। वैश्विक स्तर पर, मेटा ने इसी छह महीने की अवधि में ऐसी 33.2 मिलियन वस्तुओं पर कार्रवाई की, जिसमें 97 प्रतिशत से अधिक की पहचान सक्रिय रूप से की गई।

विशेष रूप से भारत में, 98 प्रतिशत से अधिक समस्याग्रस्त सामग्री का पता लगाया गया और किसी भी उपयोगकर्ता की रिपोर्ट से पहले समाधान किया गया। कंपनी के अनुसार, अपराधियों ने विज्ञापनों का उपयोग करके अपनी रणनीति बदल दी है जहां एक विज्ञापन अपने दम पर हानिरहित लग सकता है लेकिन लोगों को मेटा के प्लेटफ़ॉर्म से दूर होस्ट की गई अवैध सामग्री की ओर निर्देशित करता है। इस पैटर्न की पहचान करने के बाद, मेटा ने व्यक्तिगत रूप से रिपोर्ट किए गए विज्ञापनों से आगे अपनी जांच का विस्तार किया, उनसे जुड़े खातों को अक्षम किया और इसमें शामिल ऑफ-प्लेटफ़ॉर्म लिंक को ब्लॉक कर दिया।

नवीनतम उपायों में 'साइनपोस्टिंग' का पता लगाने के लिए एक बड़े भाषा मॉडल सिस्टम की सुविधा है, जिसका अर्थ विज्ञापन सामग्री है जो हानिरहित प्रतीत होती है जबकि लोगों को अवैध सामग्री की ओर निर्देशित करने का अत्यधिक संदेह होता है। इसके अलावा, मेटा ने इस बात का आकलन करने के तरीके में सुधार किया है कि विज्ञापन अंततः कहां ले जाता है न कि केवल यह दिखाता है कि यह क्या प्रदर्शित करता है। अतिरिक्त उन्नयन में पुरानी प्रणालियों द्वारा छूटी हुई सामग्री को सतह पर लाने के लिए एआई-संचालित स्वीप, कमजोरियों के लिए अपने स्वयं के सुरक्षा उपायों की जांच करने वाला एक रेड-टेमिंग एआई एजेंट, और नए खाते बनाने वाले प्रतिबंधित उपयोगकर्ताओं का पता लगाना शामिल है।

ये खुलासे भारत में बाल यौन शोषण सामग्री पर सरकार की कड़ी कार्रवाई के बीच आए हैं। जुलाई में, आईटी मंत्रालय ने इंस्टाग्राम पर ऐसे विज्ञापनों पर मेटा को एक नोटिस जारी किया और उन्हें अक्षम करने का आदेश दिया, और अपने वैश्विक अधिकारियों को भारत बुलाया। परिणामस्वरूप, मेटा ने भारतीय साइबर अपराध समन्वय केंद्र (I4C) पोर्टल को सीधे बाल सुरक्षा मामलों की रिपोर्ट करने के लिए सहमति व्यक्त की है।
hindi_translation.background_context: यह खुलासा जुलाई में एक सरकारी कार्रवाई के बाद हुआ है जब आईटी मंत्रालय ने इंस्टाग्राम पर बाल यौन शोषण विज्ञापनों के संबंध में मेटा को नोटिस जारी किया था और वैश्विक अधिकारियों को तलब किया था।
bullet_points: मेटा ने 2026 की पहली छमाही में भारत में बाल यौन शोषण सामग्री के 5.3 मिलियन मामलों पर कार्रवाई की।
वैश्विक स्तर पर, तकनीकी दिग्गज ने जनवरी और जून के बीच ऐसी 33.2 मिलियन वस्तुओं पर कार्रवाई की, जिसमें 97% से अधिक का सक्रिय रूप से पता लगाया गया।
भारत में फेसबुक और इंस्टाग्राम पर 98% से अधिक आपत्तिजनक सामग्री की रिपोर्ट होने से पहले पहचान की गई।
मेटा ने विज्ञापनों में साइनपोस्टिंग का पता लगाने के लिए बड़े भाषा मॉडल सिस्टम सहित नए एआई टूल पेश किए।
कंपनी ने सुरक्षा कमजोरियों के लिए अपने स्वयं के प्लेटफॉर्म डिफेंस का परीक्षण करने के लिए एक रेड-टेमिंग एआई एजेंट को तैनात किया।
आईटी मंत्रालय के नोटिस और अधिकारियों के सम्मन के बाद मेटा भारत के I4C साइबर क्राइम पोर्टल को सीधे बाल सुरक्षा मामलों की रिपोर्ट करने पर सहमत हुआ।

उपयोगकर्ता रिपोर्ट से पहले भारत की 98% से अधिक सामग्री का सक्रिय रूप से पता लगाया गया।

news.headline: India engaged in talks with Russia and Ukraine regarding ceasefire and Black Sea security, MEA states
news.story_lead: India announced it is in active discussions with both Russia and Ukraine regarding a comprehensive ceasefire proposal aimed at ensuring maritime security and smooth commodity supplies. The initiative includes provisions for safe merchant shipping in the Black Sea and the unhindered movement of grain and energy supplies.
news.full_article_text:
The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) confirmed on Wednesday that India is holding active conversations with Russia and Ukraine concerning a multi-part ceasefire proposal. According to MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal, the diplomatic outreach builds upon the three-part proposal conveyed by External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar during his visit to Kyiv last month. Both Moscow and Kyiv have reportedly appreciated New Delhi's proactive peace efforts.

The Indian proposal encompasses three primary elements: halting attacks on energy facilities and critical infrastructure, guaranteeing the continuous flow of grain and energy through Black Sea ports, and ending all military strikes on commercial shipping vessels navigating the strategic waterway. Prime Minister Narendra Modi's earlier message to Russian President Vladimir Putin on August 31—emphasizing that an endless war must yield to peace—serves as the foundational ethos for India's diplomatic engagement.

Simultaneously, India has strongly condemned recent attacks on four commercial vessels in the Black Sea that endangered Indian crew members. The MEA detailed specific incidents involving these ships. The Togo-flagged 'Alfa Watan' was attacked on Tuesday, leaving the fate of its crew, which includes Indian nationals, unknown. The St Kitts and Nevis-flagged 'Royad Mammadov', carrying three Indian nationals, was also targeted, resulting in injuries to one Indian who is receiving medical treatment with assistance from Romanian authorities and the Indian embassy in Sofia.

Furthermore, the Palau-flagged 'MV Able' was hit by a drone attack with 18 crew members on board, including seven Indians. One Indian seafarer sustained injuries and remains under medical supervision following timely assistance from Bulgarian authorities. The fourth vessel, the Liberia-flagged oil tanker 'Aframax Rio', carried 23 Indian crew members who were safely rescued.

The MEA highlighted that five Indian seafarers have lost their lives and multiple others have been injured in ongoing attacks on merchant shipping in the Black Sea. With a sizeable population of Indian merchant navy personnel operating in the region, India has urged both warring nations to halt hostilities against commercial shipping, restore free and unimpeded navigation, and prioritize dialogue and diplomacy to achieve a lasting peace.
bullet_points: India is holding diplomatic talks with Russia and Ukraine regarding a ceasefire proposal focusing on Black Sea security and commodity supplies.
The three-part proposal was initially conveyed by External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar during his visit to Kyiv.
The initiative includes halting attacks on energy and infrastructure facilities, ensuring grain and energy flows, and protecting commercial shipping.
India condemned recent attacks on four merchant vessels in the Black Sea involving Indian crew members.
The Togo-flagged Alfa Watan was attacked on Tuesday with the status of its crew currently unknown.
The St Kitts and Nevis-flagged Royad Mammadov sustained an attack, injuring one Indian national who received medical help via Romanian authorities.
The Palau-flagged MV Able suffered a drone attack, injuring one Indian among its seven Indian crew members, with rescue assistance provided by Bulgaria.
The Liberia-flagged oil tanker Aframax Rio and its 23 Indian crew members were successfully rescued.
Five Indian seafarers have died and several others been injured in Black Sea attacks to date, prompting intense diplomatic intervention by New Delhi.
key_facts: India's ceasefire proposal involves three parts: protecting infrastructure, securing grain and energy transit, and halting attacks on commercial shipping.
Four merchant ships carrying Indian crew members were recently attacked in the Black Sea: Alfa Watan, Royad Mammadov, MV Able, and Aframax Rio.
Five Indian seafarers have been killed so far due to attacks on merchant vessels in the Black Sea.
PM Narendra Modi met Vladimir Putin on August 31 in Kyrgyzstan, emphasizing the need to end the ongoing war.
important_dates: August 31 - Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Kyrgyzstan.
Recent week - Four commercial vessels with Indian crew members were attacked in the Black Sea.
exam_relevance: Relevant for international relations, India's foreign policy of strategic autonomy, and multilateral diplomacy in the Russia-Ukraine conflict.
news.upsc_analysis: India's diplomatic outreach to both Russia and Ukraine reflects its consistent foreign policy stance favoring dialogue and diplomacy over military escalation. By addressing critical global concerns such as food security (grain exports) and energy supply chains through the Black Sea, India demonstrates its constructive role as a global stakeholder seeking to mitigate the collateral impacts of the conflict.
causes: Escalating military conflicts in the Black Sea region affecting civilian commercial shipping and vital supply chains.
impacts: Casualties and injuries among Indian seafarers working on merchant vessels.
Disruption of international trade routes, grain shipments, and energy supplies.
challenges: Ensuring the physical safety of international merchant shipping and seafaring crews in active combat zones.
Bridging the strategic divide between Russia and Ukraine to achieve consensus on a ceasefire framework.
government_steps: Engaging in high-level diplomatic talks with both Moscow and Kyiv through the Ministry of External Affairs.
Advocating for a three-part ceasefire proposal focusing on infrastructure protection, grain and energy flow, and commercial shipping safety.
Providing consular and medical assistance to injured Indian seafarers through embassies in countries like Bulgaria and Romania.
way_forward: Continued diplomatic engagement with both belligerents and international partners to safeguard global shipping lanes and uphold international maritime law.
news.mains_notes: India's active diplomatic mediation in the Russia-Ukraine conflict highlights its growing stature as a reliable voice for global peace and supply chain stability. The focus on Black Sea security, protection of merchant seafarers, and unhindered movement of grain and energy underscores New Delhi's commitment to mitigating humanitarian and economic fallout from the war.

hindi_translation.story_lead: भारत ने घोषणा की है कि वह कमोडिटी आपूर्ति और समुद्री सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करने वाले व्यापक युद्धविराम प्रस्ताव पर रूस और यूक्रेन दोनों के साथ सक्रिय चर्चा कर रहा है।

news.headline: India Asks Russia for Update on 69 Citizens Serving in Russian Military
news.story_lead: India has requested an update from Russian authorities regarding the whereabouts of 69 Indian nationals currently serving in the Russian armed forces. The Ministry of External Affairs reiterated the grave risks involved in accepting military employment amid the ongoing conflict in Ukraine.
news.full_article_text:
The Indian government has officially sought information from Moscow concerning 69 Indian nationals who remain enlisted in the Russian military. According to statements by External Affairs Ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal, a total of 259 Indian citizens are believed to have been recruited into the Russian armed forces thus far. Through diplomatic efforts, 139 of these individuals have secured early discharges and returned or are returning, while India continues to press for the release of the remaining personnel.

Despite previous assurances from Moscow that recruitment activities have been halted, reports of Indian nationals joining the Russian military persist. The situation remains a sensitive issue in bilateral ties, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi having personally raised the matter with Russian President Vladimir Putin on multiple occasions. Previous data provided by foreign secretary Vikram Misri in August noted 227 recruits, indicating that figures have since been updated upwards.

Tragically, 51 Indian nationals, some of whom were allegedly lured through fraudulent job offers, have lost their lives on the frontlines of the Ukraine conflict. In response to these developments, the Ministry of External Affairs issued an advisory on September 30, urging citizens to avoid offers for military positions in Russia. Meanwhile, addressing concerns about a separate incident involving the death of a laboratory worker due to suspected pneumonic plague at the Irkutsk Anti-plague Research Institute in Siberia, the ministry stated that India is fully prepared to assist the approximately 30,000 Indian students and 70,000 total nationals residing in Russia if required.
news.background_context: The recruitment of Indian nationals into the Russian military has emerged as a rare diplomatic irritant between India and Russia over the past two years, prompting repeated advisories and high-level interventions by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
bullet_points: India has sought an update from Russia on the whereabouts of 69 Indian nationals still serving in the Russian armed forces.
A total of 259 Indian citizens are estimated to have been recruited into the Russian military so far.
Through bilateral efforts, 139 Indian nationals have received early discharges from the Russian Army.
Fifty-one Indians have lost their lives while serving on the frontlines of the Ukraine conflict.
Some Indian nationals were reportedly fraudulently lured into accepting civilian-looking jobs that turned into military contracts.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has personally raised the recruitment issue with Russian President Vladimir Putin.
The MEA issued a fresh advisory on September 30 warning citizens against taking up military jobs in Russia.
India has around 70,000 nationals and over 30,000 students living in Russia.
Indian authorities noted readiness to handle contingencies following a suspected pneumonic plague death of a lab worker in Siberia.

Indians granted early discharge: 139
Indians remaining with the Russian Army: 69
Indian casualties on the Ukraine frontlines: 51
Total Indian nationals in Russia: Approximately 70,000
Total Indian students in Russia: Over 30,000

news.upsc_analysis: The issue highlights the challenges of diaspora protection, fraudulent human trafficking networks operating under the guise of foreign employment, and bilateral diplomacy between strategic partners.

impacts: Fifty-one Indian fatalities on the frontlines of the conflict in Ukraine.

While traditional ties remain robust, India has actively intervened at leadership levels—including PM Modi's discussions with President Putin—to secure the discharge of 139 out of 259 recruited Indians. The situation underscores the need for stringent action against fraudulent recruitment syndicates and enhanced awareness through government advisories.

hindi_translation.story_lead: भारत ने बुधवार को कहा कि उसने रूसी सशस्त्र बलों में सेवा दे रहे 69 भारतीय नागरिकों के ठिकानों के बारे में रूसी अधिकारियों से जानकारी मांगी है। साथ ही, यूक्रेन संघर्ष के बीच सेना की नौकरियों के प्रस्ताव स्वीकार करने के गंभीर खतरों को भी दोहराया गया है।

news.headline: Lok Sabha LoP Rahul Gandhi Hands Out Water to Delhi Police During Detention at INDIA Bloc Protest
news.story_lead: Lok Sabha Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi was seen distributing water bottles and praising Delhi Police personnel for their work after being briefly detained during an INDIA bloc protest march toward Jantar Mantar. The opposition coalition has been staging demonstrations demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral irregularities.
news.full_article_text:
Lok Sabha Leader of Opposition and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi was observed handing out water bottles to Delhi Police personnel on Wednesday after being detained during a political protest. Gandhi, along with several other MPs from the INDIA bloc, was en route to Jantar Mantar in Delhi to stage a sit-in demonstration when security forces intercepted and detained him and other leaders, including his sister and MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra.

The demonstrations form part of a coordinated two-day protest by opposition parties demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (ECI) Gyanesh Kumar. The opposition alleges that recent irregularities in the rollout of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process are intended to strip genuine voters of their rights and constitute a broader plan of vote theft. 

Video footage from the site showed Rahul Gandhi sitting inside a detention bus and offering water bottles to the surrounding police personnel while telling them they were performing good work. The protest sequence began earlier when opposition MPs marched from Parliament toward the Election Commission of India office on Day 1, only to encounter police barricades at entry points. After entering the Akashvani Bhavan building to protest, several leaders including Rahul Gandhi were detained and subsequently released, with the Delhi Police registering First Information Reports (FIRs) against multiple MPs.

Following a lunch meeting hosted by Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge on Wednesday to formulate the next phase of the agitation, opposition members resolved to continue demonstrations at Jantar Mantar. Transported in three buses, the leaders were again intercepted and detained. TMC MP Derek O'Brien affirmed that the opposition protests would persist despite ongoing detentions and the filing of FIRs.
news.background_context: The INDIA bloc launched a multi-day protest targeting the Election Commission of India over alleged discrepancies in the rollout of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process, which opposition parties claim removes genuine voters from rolls.
bullet_points: Rahul Gandhi distributed water bottles to Delhi Police personnel from inside a detention bus while telling them they were doing good work.
The detention occurred on Wednesday as INDIA bloc MPs traveled in three buses from a lunch meeting toward Jantar Mantar to stage a sit-in protest.
Opposition parties are demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities and vote theft linked to the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process.
This marked the second consecutive day of protests by the INDIA bloc, following a march from Parliament to the ECI office on Day 1 that faced police barricades and detentions at Akashvani Bhavan.
Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge hosted a lunch meeting in Delhi for INDIA bloc MPs to strategize the continuation of protests.
Samajwadi Party led by Akhilesh Yadav skipped the lunch meeting due to delayed communication.
TMC MP Derek O'Brien and other opposition leaders confirmed that protests would continue despite police detentions and registered FIRs against participating MPs.
key_facts: Rahul Gandhi serves as the Lok Sabha Leader of Opposition (LoP) and a senior Congress leader.
The Chief Election Commissioner facing opposition demands for resignation is Gyanesh Kumar.
The protests center on allegations surrounding the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process.
Day 1 protests involved a march from Parliament to the Election Commission of India office, culminating in detention at Akashvani Bhavan.
Day 2 protests shifted venue to Jantar Mantar following a lunch meeting hosted by Mallikarjun Kharge.
Delhi Police registered FIRs against Rahul Gandhi and several other opposition MPs.
important_dates: Wednesday (2026-10-07): Day 2 of the INDIA bloc protest, detention of MPs traveling to Jantar Mantar, and lunch meeting hosted by Mallikarjun Kharge
exam_relevance: Useful for understanding democratic norms, opposition politics, and the role of law enforcement agencies during political protests in India.
news.upsc_analysis: The news highlights ongoing friction between opposition political parties and constitutional bodies such as the Election Commission of India, alongside the handling of public demonstrations and detentions by law enforcement agencies.
causes: Alleged irregularities and vote-stripping concerns associated with the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process conducted by the Election Commission of India.
impacts: Repeated detentions of opposition MPs across multiple days of protests in Delhi.
Filing of police FIRs against Rahul Gandhi and other participating parliamentarians.
challenges: Managing political demonstrations and maintaining public order in the national capital while balancing democratic rights of protest.
government_steps: Delhi Police deployed barricades, detained protesting MPs, and registered FIRs against participants for defying restrictions.
constitutional_or_policy_link: Relates to the functioning, autonomy, and public accountability of the Election Commission of India under constitutional frameworks.
way_forward: Constructive dialogue between institutional authorities and political parties to address concerns regarding electoral processes and uphold democratic accountability.
news.mains_notes: The protests led by opposition INDIA bloc MPs against the Chief Election Commissioner underline growing political tensions over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) electoral process. Incidents involving police detentions, the filing of FIRs, and shifting protest venues from the ECI office to Jantar Mantar reflect broader debates surrounding the administrative oversight of elections, freedom of peaceful assembly, and the engagement between political representatives and law enforcement agencies.

news.headline: India and Canada strengthen bilateral security cooperation on counter-terrorism and extradition
news.story_lead: India's National Security Adviser Ajit Doval and Canadian counterpart David Morrison held high-level talks to deepen coordination on transnational crime, terrorism, drug trafficking, and the extradition of criminal offenders. The discussions marked a progressive step in bilateral security and law enforcement collaboration following the implementation of a shared security work plan.
news.full_article_text:
India and Canada have formally reviewed their bilateral security cooperation, agreeing to boost joint efforts against transnational organised crime, drug trafficking, terrorism, and the extradition of criminal offenders. The high-level discussions took place during a visit to India by David Morrison, senior diplomatic and international affairs adviser to the Canadian Prime Minister, who was in the country from October 5 to 7. The core dialogue between Morrison and Indian National Security Adviser Ajit Doval occurred on Tuesday, reinforcing a key diplomatic mechanism designed to address mutual security concerns.

During the meeting, both security officials evaluated the progress achieved under a shared "security work plan" that was concluded earlier in February 2026. According to a joint statement released on Wednesday, the two nations committed to deepening collaboration across several sensitive fronts, including combating violent extremism, human and drug trafficking, cybercrime, extortion, and the legal extradition of fugitives. Additionally, both sides planned to establish structured dialogues focusing on cybersecurity and economic security, alongside reinforcing institutional mechanisms for streamlined communication and rapid information-sharing.

Bilateral ties had previously experienced severe strains following allegations made in September 2023 by former Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau concerning the killing of Khalistani separatist Hardeep Singh Nijjar, an assertion India firmly rejected as absurd. While India has consistently emphasized concerns over Canada-based Khalistani elements linked to organised crime, Canada has focused on transnational gangs operating with ties to India. Relations have since seen structured recovery efforts, including National Security Adviser-level bilateral security dialogues held in New Delhi in September 2025 and in Ottawa in February 2026, leading to sustained and constructive engagement guided by mutual trust and respect for each other's sensitivities.

Beyond internal security, the two countries expressed satisfaction with ongoing diplomatic engagements, welcomed advances in negotiations for a comprehensive economic partnership agreement, and discussed potential avenues for a deeper bilateral defence relationship while exchanging perspectives on broader regional and global developments.
news.background_context: Bilateral relations suffered a severe downturn after former Canadian PM Justin Trudeau alleged in September 2023 that Indian government agents were linked to the murder of Khalistani separatist Hardeep Singh Nijjar, an accusation dismissed by India as absurd.
bullet_points: India and Canada reviewed security cooperation during a meeting between NSA Ajit Doval and Canadian counterpart David Morrison in India.
David Morrison visited India from October 5 to 7, with the main bilateral dialogue held on Tuesday.

The two nations agreed to coordinate closely on combating transnational organised crime, terrorism, drug and human trafficking, cybercrime, and extortion.
Plans include establishing structured dialogues on cybersecurity and economic security and improving timely information-sharing channels.
India's primary concern centers on Canada-based Khalistani elements and organised crime, while Canada focuses on transnational criminal gangs with ties to India.
Previous NSA-level security dialogues were held in New Delhi in September 2025 and Ottawa in February 2026.
Both countries welcomed progress toward a comprehensive economic partnership agreement and discussed potential advancements in bilateral defence ties.

hindi_translation.headline: भारत और कनाडा ने अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अपराध, आतंकवाद और प्रत्यर्पण पर समन्वय गहरा करने पर सहमति जताई
hindi_translation.story_lead: भारत के राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा सलाहकार अजीत डोभाल और उनके क Canadian समकक्ष डेविड मॉरिसन ने सीमा पार संगठित अपराध, आतंकवाद, ड्रग तस्करी और अपराधियों के प्रत्यर्पण से निपटने में आपसी समन्वय को बढ़ाने के लिए उच्च स्तरीय वार्ता की।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: भारत और कनाडा ने अपनी सुरक्षा सहयोग की समीक्षा की है और सीमा पार संगठित अपराध, आतंकवाद, ड्रग तस्करी और अपराधियों के प्रत्यर्पण से निपटने के लिए समन्वय मजबूत करने पर सहमति व्यक्त की है। यह बैठक भारत के राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा सलाहकार अजीत डोभाल और कनाडा के प्रधानमंत्री के वरिष्ठ कूटनीतिक और अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मामलों के सलाहकार डेविड मॉरिसन के बीच हुई। मॉरिसन 5 से 7 अक्टूबर तक भारत की यात्रा पर थे। दोनों पक्षों के बीच सुरक्षा चिंताओं को दूर करने के लिए यह संवाद एक महत्वपूर्ण तंत्र के रूप में उभरा है। दोनों सुरक्षा अधिकारियों ने फरवरी 2026 में संपन्न हुए 'सुरक्षा कार्य योजना' के कार्यान्वयन सहित द्विपक्षीय सुरक्षा और कानून प्रवर्तन सहयोग में हुई प्रगति की समीक्षा की। एक संयुक्त बयान के अनुसार, दोनों पक्षों ने आतंकवाद, हिंसक उग्रवाद, मानव और मादक पदार्थों की तस्करी, साइबर अपराध, जबरन वसूली और अपराधियों के प्रत्यर्पण के खिलाफ सहयोग को और गहरा करने पर सहमति जताई। इसके अलावा, उन्होंने साइबर सुरक्षा और आर्थिक सुरक्षा पर संरचित संवाद स्थापित करने और आपसी चिंता के मामलों पर सुव्यवस्थित संचार और समय पर सूचना साझा करने के लिए नए चैनल बनाने पर भी सहमति व्यक्त की। सितंबर 2023 में खालिस्तानी अलगाववादी हरदीप सिंह निज्जर की हत्या से जुड़े आरोपों के बाद दोनों देशों के संबंधों में तनाव आ गया था, जिसे भारत ने खारिज कर दिया था। भारत की मुख्य चिंता कनाडा स्थित खालिस्तानी तत्वों और संगठित अपराध के बीच संबंध हैं, जबकि कनाडा ने भारत से जुड़े अंतरराष्ट्रीय आपराधिक गिरोहों की गतिविधियों का मुद्दा उठाया है। हाल के दौर में दोनों पक्षों ने आपसी विश्वास और संवेदनशीलता के आधार पर अपने संबंधों को पटरी पर लाने के लिए कई बैठकें की हैं। संयुक्त बयान में कहा गया है कि दोनों पक्ष पिछले एक साल के दौरान निरंतर और रचनात्मक वार्ताओं से संतुष्ट हैं। उन्होंने व्यापक आर्थिक साझेदारी समझौते के लिए बातचीत को आगे बढ़ाने और द्विपक्षीय रक्षा संबंधों को मजबूत करने की क्षमता पर भी चर्चा की।
hindi_translation.background_context: सितंबर 2023 में तत्कालीन कनाडाई पीएम जस्टिन ट्रूडो द्वारा खालिस्तानी अलगाववादी हरदीप सिंह निज्जर की हत्या में भारतीय एजेंटों के शामिल होने के आरोप के बाद संबंधों में गिरावट आई थी, जिसे भारत ने खारिज कर दिया था।

साइबर सुरक्षा और आर्थिक सुरक्षा पर संरचित संवाद स्थापित करने की योजना है।
भारत की मुख्य चिंता कनाडा स्थित खालिस्तानी तत्व हैं, जबकि कनाडा की चिंता भारत से जुड़े आपराधिक गिरोह हैं।
इससे पहले सितंबर 2025 में नई दिल्ली और फरवरी 2026 में ओटावा में एनएसए स्तर की बैठकें हुई थीं।

news.headline: BJP accuses Rahul Gandhi of pushing woman police personnel during opposition protest
news.story_lead: The Bharatiya Janata Party has alleged that senior Congress leader Rahul Gandhi attempted to push a woman police officer during an INDIA bloc protest in New Delhi. The demonstration was organized by opposition parliamentarians on Ashoka Road to demand the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over allegations of electoral malpractice.
news.full_article_text: Opposition parliamentarians belonging to the INDIA bloc staged a sit-in demonstration on Ashoka Road to register protests regarding allegations of 'vote chori' and to demand the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. This protest followed an eight-hour dharna held a day prior, which was aimed at securing a meeting with election commissioners. The opposition leaders initially planned to assemble at Jantar Mantar, but law enforcement authorities intercepted and stopped them at a roundabout on Ashoka Road. The decision to hold the protest at Jantar Mantar was announced unexpectedly following a solidarity lunch hosted by Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge. Following the lunch, the parliamentarians boarded buses, with some climbing onto the vehicle roofs carrying the tricolour. The procession moved from Janpath toward Jantar Mantar, causing major traffic disruptions and bringing the high-security area to a standstill for the second consecutive day. During the demonstration, law enforcement personnel forcibly removed and detained several prominent leaders, including Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra. The participating political parties included the Congress, TMC, CPI(M), CPI, RJD, and IUML, whereas Samajwadi Party MPs were absent from the protest. Amidst these events, the BJP released video footage through party spokesperson Pradeep Bhandari, alleging that Rahul Gandhi tried to push a female police officer while she and her team were attempting to remove a female protester from the site.
bullet_points: INDIA bloc opposition MPs held a sit-in protest on Ashoka Road to demand the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
Protesters raised slogans and issues related to alleged vote theft ('vote chori').
The demonstration followed an earlier eight-hour dharna by opposition leaders seeking a meeting with election commissioners.
Police stopped the procession at a roundabout on Ashoka Road after leaders attempted to march from Janpath toward Jantar Mantar.
Parliamentarians and leaders, including Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, were forcibly removed and detained by the police.
Parties participating in the protest included Congress, TMC, CPI(M), CPI, RJD, and IUML, while Samajwadi Party MPs did not attend.
The BJP accused Rahul Gandhi of trying to push a female police officer during the removal of women protesters, sharing video footage of the incident.

hindi_translation.headline: विपक्ष के प्रदर्शन के दौरान महिला पुलिसकर्मी को धक्का देने की कोशिश का भाजपा ने लगाया राहुल गांधी पर आरोप
hindi_translation.story_lead: भारतीय जनता पार्टी ने आरोप लगाया है कि कांग्रेस नेता राहुल गांधी ने नई दिल्ली में विपक्षी 'इंडिया' ब्लॉक के प्रदर्शन के दौरान एक महिला पुलिसकर्मी को धक्का देने का प्रयास किया। यह विरोध प्रदर्शन विपक्ष के सांसदों द्वारा 'वोट चोरी' के मुद्दों को उठाने और मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार को हटाने की मांग को लेकर किया गया था।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: विपक्षी 'इंडिया' ब्लॉक के सांसदों ने 'वोट चोरी' के मुद्दों को उठाने और मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार को हटाने की मांग को लेकर अशोक रोड पर धरना प्रदर्शन किया। यह प्रदर्शन चुनाव आयुक्तों से मिलने की मांग को लेकर किए गए आठ घंटे के धरने के ठीक एक दिन बाद हुआ। विपक्षी नेता जंतर-मंतर पर प्रदर्शन करना चाहते थे, लेकिन पुलिस ने उन्हें अशोक रोड पर एक गोल चक्कर के पास रोक लिया। कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष मल्लिकार्जुन खड़गे द्वारा आयोजित एकजुटता भोज के तुरंत बाद जंतर-मंतर पर प्रदर्शन करने की अचानक घोषणा की गई थी। इसके तुरंत बाद सांसद बसों में सवार हो गए, जिनमें से कुछ तिरंगा लेकर बसों की छतों पर चढ़ गए। यह जुलूस जनपथ से जंतर-मंतर की ओर बढ़ा, जिससे लगातार दूसरे दिन उच्च सुरक्षा वाले इलाके में आवागमन ठप हो गया। इस दौरान राहुल गांधी, प्रियंका गांधी वाड्रा और अन्य 'इंडिया' ब्लॉक के नेताओं को पुलिस ने बलपूर्वक हटाकर हिरासत में ले लिया। प्रदर्शन में कांग्रेस, टीएमसी, सीपीआई (एम), सीपीआई, आरजेडी और आईयूएमएल के सांसद शामिल थे, जबकि समाजवादी पार्टी के सांसद मौजूद नहीं थे। इस बीच, भाजपा प्रवक्ता प्रदीप भंडारी ने सोशल मीडिया पर एक वीडियो क्लिप साझा करते हुए कांग्रेस नेता पर हमला बोला और आरोप लगाया कि राहुल गांधी ने महिला पुलिसकर्मी को धक्का देने का प्रयास किया।
bullet_points: मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार को हटाने की मांग को लेकर 'इंडिया' ब्लॉक के सांसदों ने अशोक रोड पर धरना प्रदर्शन किया।
प्रदर्शनकारियों ने 'वोट चोरी' के आरोपों से जुड़े मुद्दों पर नारेबाजी की।
यह प्रदर्शन चुनाव आयुक्तों से मिलने की मांग वाले पिछले धरने के बाद आयोजित किया गया था।
जनपथ से जंतर-मंतर की ओर मार्च करने के प्रयास के दौरान पुलिस ने जुलूस को अशोक रोड पर रोक दिया।
राहुल गांधी और प्रियंका गांधी वाड्रा सहित कई नेताओं को पुलिस ने हिरासत में ले लिया।
कांग्रेस, टीएमसी, सीपीआई(एम), सीपीआई, आरजेडी और आईयूएमएल के नेता इसमें शामिल थे।
भाजपा ने वीडियो जारी कर राहुल गांधी पर प्रदर्शन के दौरान महिला पुलिसकर्मी को धक्का देने की कोशिश का आरोप लगाया।
